additional_info.body:

additional_info.subject: ID0424406-DC/Si-D/SA-[ MP / N8 160368830 ] charger is stuck CRM:00642002290
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Desert Technologies Factory for Industries CJSC
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N8 160368830
Charger ID/Serial No.:
wq9QKF
Problem Description: C
harger is stuck
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 08/07/2023, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Please find the configuration file of the charger attached. Below are the steps that need to be performed related to flashing the CFAST card and restoring the configuration. I hope you already having the Live Linux user scripts with you, if not please let us know we will share it via Secufex or OneDrive.
Download and extraction of firmware from SCB
Download and extraction of Live Linux image
Download of SW tools required
Flashing of Live Linux image on 32GB USB stick
Flashing of firmware on CFast card
Please download the current FW image from SCB, You can find the firmware here:
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/firmware-images/list
Here's the setup required for the intervention:
HW Devices:
Laptop With Admin Rights.
Should be able to access dual network (Both ethernet/Wifi)
2 Ethernet cables
1 or 2 USB drivers 32 GB.
CFast Card Reader
Electric ties
SW Tools:
MobaXterm
HDD Raw Copy Tool Portable
Bunzip2
Rufus
Companion tool
7 Zip
Software:
Live Linux user scripts
Config file of the charger (already shared on the email)
Preparation:
Download of the firmware image from SCB
Flashing of FW image on Cfast card via Rufus or Flashing FW image on CFast card via Companion tool
Extraction of Live Linux Image via 7zip (depends on laptop performance)
Flashing of Live Linux image on USB driver(make sure to create the Data folder in the root if the USB)
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
